ownerStatement: Approved by repeat98 on 27 Oct 2026 in the issue-fix session ("approved"): release Tape Echo 0.1.6-experimental with BBD's MIX law and default MIX 40 (#969).
reason: Owner released the Tape Echo MIX law change for issue #969 after software verification: the ColdFire kernels match the native oracle bit for bit and every Tape Echo gate passes on the emulator. No chip-cycle or complete memory measurement exists for this version and the earlier freeze at seven instances remains open. This binds only this exact version and native source; on 27 Oct 2026 the USB package was measured on a unit (levels at MIX 0/40/64/90/127, MIX sweeps without clicks; TESTING.md), while the card build, a seventh instance and listening stay untested.
